04 / Trust

Clear before
you approve.

SPLIT is designed to show the important payment details before a wallet request is opened.

Payment clarity

Know what you are paying and where it is going.

The participant view surfaces the requested amount, network, asset and creator payout destination before payment. Wallet approval happens through the user’s own wallet interface.

No seed phrase requestsSPLIT should never ask users to enter private keys or recovery phrases.
Visible recipientThe receiving address can be shown before the transaction is submitted.
Network confirmationThe selected network is explicit before the payment flow begins.
Asset confirmationThe selected payment asset is visible before wallet approval.
Creator controlConnect or enter an address

Creators can choose how they provide their payout destination.

Participant controlApprove in your own wallet

The wallet remains the place where the user reviews and approves the transaction.

Shared statusPaid and pending in one view

Payment state stays visible to the group instead of disappearing into chat threads.

Solana wallets

Choose a wallet.

SPLIT uses Solana Wallet Standard when available, so installed compatible wallets can connect without sharing private keys.

Initial buy Minimum $5 USDC-equivalent. This amount is converted to SOL and used as the launch wallet's fee-free first buy into the token bonding curve.
Genesis first buys settle in SOL. Your wallet will show the exact SOL transaction before approval.
On mobile: tap Phantom, Solflare or Backpack to open this SPLIT page inside the installed wallet app. Android users can also choose Device Wallet to open a compatible installed wallet through Solana Mobile Wallet Adapter.
Open your wallet app's built-in browser and paste the link if your phone blocks wallet app links.
Other installed wallets
Only approve connections and transactions you recognize. SPLIT will never ask for a seed phrase or private key.
If you genuinely do not have a wallet installed, use the wallet's official website to install it. The wallet buttons above are for connecting/opening installed wallets, not downloading them.

Token details

Add the information people will see when your token launches.

No SPLIT platform launch fee Every launch includes a required first buy of at least $5 USDC-equivalent into the token bonding curve. Metaplex Genesis settles that first buy in SOL. Normal on-chain/network costs also apply.

Fee routing

This split is fixed for every SPLIT launch and is enforced by the server. Creators cannot edit the percentages.

Revenue reserve Fixed35% is routed to the configured SPLIT revenue reserve. This is not automatic DEX LP provisioning.

SPLIT never needs your seed phrase. The connected wallet approves every on-chain transaction. Every launch includes a minimum $5 USDC-equivalent first buy into the token bonding curve; Metaplex Genesis settles it in SOL. SPLIT's 10% is taken only from the creator-revenue pool — not 10% of every trade. Creator / Treasury / Reserve / Protocol is fixed at 35% / 20% / 35% / 10%.
